title: yafuce's Stacking Potion
description: Increases potions stack sizes. Makes potion relevant again !
body:
The fact that potions are unstackable outweighs almost all of their benefits. As they stand, potions are just cluttering you precious inventory space.

This super light server side mod simply increases their stack sizes. It is now worthwhile bringing some with you! Long water breathing sessions, speedboost to travel on the nether roof, any many other use cases.

Makes potion relevant again !

---

- Drinkable potions
  - Stacks to **8**
- Splash potions
  - Stacks to **4**
- Lingering potions
  - Stacks to **4**
